description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the BuzzPhotoController in the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It contains test methods to verify photo handling, response headers, caching behavior, and error handling for non-existing or missing photo IDs.

classes.name: BuzzPhotoControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the BuzzPhotoController's behavior in various scenarios including cache validation, content delivery, and handling of missing or invalid photo IDs.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up test fixtures before any test runs by loading predefined test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testHandle
methods.description: Tests retrieving a photo with proper headers, content, and ETag handling.

methods.name: testHandleMultipleRequestWithoutETag
methods.description: Tests the response when requesting a photo without an existing ETag, expecting a successful image retrieval.

methods.name: testHandleNonExistingPhotoId
methods.description: Verifies behavior when requesting a non-existent photo ID, expecting a 400 error.

methods.name: testHandleWithoutId
methods.description: Checks response when no photo ID is provided in the request, expecting a 400 error.
